critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx (line 63): the CASE C fix (call serverEmailExists on the fallback path) is correct and minimal — server 401 + no local account now branches on the new backend probe. Behaviour matches the spec exactly.

api.ts serverEmailExists: 20s timeout + AbortController + swallow-non-OK → returns false. Good — a flaky email-exists probe cannot spuriously turn a wrong-email error into the wrong-password-on-server one. On real offline, serverLogin already threw OfflineError before reaching this line, so no extra network chatter offline.

ReconnectSheet.tsx: wrapping the sheet body in a ScrollView with maxHeight 90% at the Modal level fixed the previously off-viewport submit issue on 390x844 web preview. The ScrollView.flexGrow=0 + scrollContent.justifyContent='flex-end' keeps the sheet pinned to the bottom on tall viewports without changing the native (iOS/Android) look.

Backend /api/auth/email-exists endpoint responds correctly (200 + {exists:true|false}) and does NOT require auth — appropriate for this specific use case since the client only asks after a fresh 401 from the same email; enumeration risk is bounded by the same rate limit that would already exist on /api/auth/login.
app.json: name='DermaLens AI', version='1.1.2', versionCode=122 — all correct in the served bundle.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For any future ReconnectSheet layout regression, use viewport 390x844 and check the bounding_box of both testID='reconnect-password' AND testID='reconnect-submit' — expected y+height ≤ 844. For CASE E the reproducible way to force needsReconnect from Playwright is to await page.route('**/api/auth/login', route => route.abort()) AND page.route('**/api/auth/me', route => route.abort()) BEFORE clicking login-submit; the app falls into localSignIn via the OfflineError catch and sets needsReconnect=true. To force logout from Home, use testID='header-logout' and pre-register a page.on('dialog', d => d.accept()) handler because Home uses window.confirm on web. For CASE B, delete the user from Mongo (test_database.users, collection field 'email') AFTER signup and BEFORE signing out — keep browser storage — then log in again and watch for the login(401)+signup(201) pair. Gemini key was NOT invoked; safe to leave GEMINI_API_KEY as-is.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 19 flagged two issues: (a) CASE C produced generic 'Email or password is incorrect.' text and (b) CASE E's reconnect-submit rendered below a 390x844 viewport. Both are now fixed. (a) Root cause was that auth.tsx line 60 threw BAD_CREDENTIALS as soon as localVerify returned null; the fix adds a new backend endpoint GET /api/auth/email-exists and calls it in auth.tsx at the same spot (line 63) so that when server 401 + local absent, the app can distinguish 'unknown email' from 'email exists on server with a different password' and pick the correct copy. Verified end-to-end via network trace + on-screen error text. (b) Root cause was `KeyboardAvoidingView behavior='padding'` on react-native-web adding enough bottom padding to push the button out of a 390x844 viewport in a slide Modal. The fix wraps the sheet content in ScrollView (maxHeight 90%) with flexGrow=0 so the sheet is now scrollable and both fields have y+height ≤ 844. Verified via Playwright bounding_box measurement and a successful submit that cleared the banner.
